summary: Canadian Natural Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, with an attached press release announcing a quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share, payable July 7, 2026 to shareholders of record June 19, 2026. The filing notes the board increased the dividend in March 2026, continuing a 26-year track record of increases with a 20% CAGR. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special situation or corporate action such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant's role is as issuer of the dividend. No deal terms or event-driven dynamics are present.
